newsitem.title: USA: Soros group holds 22.97 pct Gateway stake.
newsitem.headline: Soros group holds 22.97 pct Gateway stake.

text.p: A group led by internatioal financier George Soros said Monday it holds the equivalent of a 22.97 percent stake or 827,716 common shares in Gateway Industries Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said that of its stake, it acquired 778,000 shares under a rights offering of Gateway. The rights entitles holders of each common share buy three additional shares at $2.25 a share.
The group said it holds the stake for investment.
